description: Pytest fixture setup for integration tests of the notes_backend application, including environment variable setup, application import, test client creation, and authentication token retrieval.

methods.name: None _set_required_env()
methods.description: Sets required environment variables for testing, including database connection details and JWT secret key, if they are not already set.

methods.name: Any app()
methods.description: Imports the FastAPI application from src.api.main after environment setup.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[AsyncClient] client(app: Any)
methods.description: Creates and yields an Async HTTP client configured for testing the FastAPI app.

methods.name: str _signup_and_get_token(ac: AsyncClient, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Signs up a user via POST request and retrieves an access token from the response.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] auth_headers(client: AsyncClient)
methods.description: Creates a new user and returns the authorization headers containing the bearer token.

ctags.name: _signup_and_get_token
ctags.pattern: /^async def _signup_and_get_token(ac: AsyncClient, *, email: str, password: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: fastapi_app
ctags.pattern: /^    from src.api.main import app as fastapi_app  # noqa: WPS433 (allow import inside function)$/
